metadata.name: mimir
metadata.description: Mimir — AI-settled claim market on Solana with MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: challenge_claim
docs: Works on BOTH layers (zero-fee inside the ER).

accounts.name: agent_fees
docs: FeeBalance of the challenger's agent. Required only when an agent fee is due.

accounts.name: agent_fees
docs: FeeBalance of claim.creator_agent. Required only when an agent fee is due.

errors.name: GraceOutOfRange
errors.msg: Mimir: resolution grace out of range

errors.name: CannotDelegate
errors.msg: Mimir: claim cannot be delegated in this state

fields.name: agent
docs: Agent owner credited for this position (Pubkey::default() = none).

fields.name: resolution_summary
docs: Proposal summary while PROPOSED/DISPUTED, final summary once RESOLVED.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin transfer: set by propose_admin, cleared by accept_admin.

fields.name: paused
docs: Stops create/challenge/propose. Never stops withdraw, payouts, refunds, disputes.

fields.name: dispute_window
docs: Seconds a proposed verdict stays disputable (snapshotted per claim). 0 = settle instantly.

fields.name: resolution_grace
docs: Seconds after the deadline an unresolved claim becomes refundable (snapshotted per claim).

fields.name: fees_accrued
docs: Outstanding platform fees + forfeited bonds held in the vault, withdrawable via withdraw_fees.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Room for future fields without a migration.

fields.name: agent
docs: Owner of the agent that opened this position; earns agent_fee_bps of the creator's profit.

types.name: FeeBalance
docs: Agent-owner fee accrual for one recipient. Never pushed: the owner pulls
it with claim_agent_fees, so a recipient can never block a payout.
